engaged.rule: E1 and E2 both >= 10 Hz in the same seed, in >= 5 of 8 seeds

expectations.X3: MINUS_SENSORY equals LIVE and ONLY_SENSORY equals ISOLATED

gates.ISOLATED: equals F1 S1_ISOLATED DNg100_L 100 Hz runs exactly (score, mn_spikes, core, F1's network-only active fraction)
gates.LIVE: equals F1 S0_LIVE DNg100_L 100 Hz runs exactly (score, mn_spikes, core, active_fraction)
gates.LIVE_VIA_WEIGHTS: equals LIVE exactly (score, mn_spikes, core, active_fraction, active_neurons)

groups.rule: superclass: contains sensory -> SENSORY; ol_/visual_ -> OPTIC; cb_ -> BRAIN; descending_neuron/efferent_descending -> DN; ascending_neuron/efferent_ascending -> AN; vnc_ -> VNC; else OTHER

harness: lif_driver_rhythm.one via engine_fidelity_audit conventions; 3 s; Poisson forced drive
interpretation_limits: One DN (DNg100_L), one rate (100 Hz), the front-left network and 8 seeds.
Groups are coarse superclass partitions; "not needed" does not mean "no effect".
The only lesion type is transmission removal (outgoing weights zeroed).
The 10 Hz engagement bar is declared, not derived.
Neural only: no body or physics. Motor coordinates unchanged (20/42 admitted, +4 conditional).
labels: INCONCLUSIVE: a gate or lesion audit fails, the run is incomplete, or LIVE is not engaged
LOCALISED: some group is NEEDED (MINUS not engaged) and SUFFICIENT (ONLY engaged)
NEEDED_NOT_SUFFICIENT: some group NEEDED, no NEEDED group SUFFICIENT
REDUNDANT: no group NEEDED, some group SUFFICIENT

lesions.ISOLATED: only edges inside the network kept
lesions.MINUS: outgoing edges of the group zeroed
lesions.ONLY: only edges with both ends in the network or the group kept
